messages:
emma_support: FYI customer GammaApps is getting a flood of 429s but the Console shows plenty of quota left. They pasted a request_id and a curl. Can we triage?

emma_support: request_id=rid_0a9f3b, region=eu-west-1, approx 2026-03-15T14:03:21Z. sample curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

sanjay_sre: pinging infra. do we have enforcer logs for rid_0a9f3b? also which env (prod vs dedicated)?

emma_support: prod. pasted enforcer response body: `{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"code\":429,\"policy\":\"burst_per_minute\"}`. console panel for GammaApps -> Rate Usage shows available quota ~120k tokens in window.

li_platform: most of the time when enforcement != console it's ingestion latency or a counter mismatch between enforcer store and analytics aggregates. can someone check consumer lag for `quota-meter-ingestor` in eu-west-1? run: `kafka-consumer-groups --group quota-meter-ingestor --describe --bootstrap-server kafka-eu:9092`

emma_support: ran the command, output tiny snippet: `CURRENT-OFFSET 452345, LOG-END-OFFSET 584123, LAG 131778` — big lag.

quota-ingest-bot: alert: quota-meter-ingestor consumer lag (eu-west-1) = 131778 messages, last commit 2026-03-15T14:01:50Z.

li_platform: yep that's the gap. console panels use analytics after ingest; enforcer reads live counters/redis. But our enforcer can also consult aggregate counters when redis misses — if the aggregator is delayed, enforcer may still enforce based on more conservative snapshot or cached policy thresholds -> leading to 429s while console hasn't updated yet.

sanjay_sre: quick mitigation: restart quota-meter-ingestor pod to force leader rebalance and accelerate commits. also check Clickhouse insert queue (disk pressure sometimes pauses writes). command: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/quota-meter-ingestor-eu`

emma_support: restarted, logs show catch-up starting: `consumed=452360 commit=452360 lag=131763`. watching console panels. asked customer to hold for ~2m.

marta_product: what caused the jump in lag? we should tell CS what happened and an ETA to avoid escalations.

li_platform: early signs: a Kafka broker had a partition leader bounce around 14:00 -> pause in consumption. also one of the ingestors hit OOM and was OOMKilled at 13:59 (restarted automatically). combination caused backlog. will open infra ticket to pin the partitions and increase ingestor replicas.

sanjay_sre: for root cause / follow-up: collect enforcer logs around 14:00 and ingestor consumer offsets, also the enforcer->redis latency graph. please add these artifacts to the support case. commands: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/enforcer --since=30m | grep rid_0a9f3b -A5 -B2` and `clickhouse-client --query 'SELECT * FROM quota_events WHERE request_id=\"rid_0a9f3b\"'`

emma_support: pulled enforcer logs and uploaded to case. clickhouse returned no rows for rid_0a9f3b (not yet ingested). told customer that we restarted pipeline and are monitoring.

quota-ingest-bot: update: consumer lag falling, now 54k messages behind.

gammaapps-customer-bot: GammaApps thread: "Thanks, we saw requests resume around 14:04:50Z. No more 429s after ~90s. Will confirm if anything else breaks." :white_check_mark:

li_platform: postmortem actions: 1) increase ingestor HPA min replicas in eu-west-1, 2) add alert for consumer lag > 1m messages, 3) harden OOM memory requests on ingestor, 4) add note in Console docs about ingestion latency window (panels can lag by up to ~2m in edge cases).

marta_product: please draft a short CS blurb for affected customers explaining ingestion lag can cause temporary mismatch between Console and enforcement, and what we did to fix it.

emma_support: will draft and send. closing loop when infra ticket and PRs are linked in case.

sanjay_sre: thumbs up. saving logs and offsets to the incident folder.

emma_support: thanks all :heart:
